profile.description: Arriyadh Development Co. leases and manages residential and non-residential properties in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The company purchases, sells, manages, and leases land and real estate properties, as well as develops residential and commercial buildings. It also engages in wholesale and retail of new and used private cars, including ambulances, minibuses, and four-wheel drive vehicles. The company was founded in 1993 and is headquartered in Riyadh, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.
